# Partial research checkpoint

Latest local assessment cutoff: 2024-08-31T23:59:59+00:00. Fictional teaching evidence only; not Apple facts or an investment recommendation. No external freshness verification or acquisition occurred.

## Business
The supplied Business extract says services renewals support recurring revenue while hardware demand is cyclical. MD&A reports units down 5% and services up 8%; these measure different things and cannot be netted or used to infer total revenue, margins, pricing power, or intrinsic value. Currency and mix changed, and no price/volume bridge is supplied. Recurrence is a potential stabilizer, not proof of a durable moat: distribution concentration and antitrust remedies could reduce service margins (Risk factors). Missing notes, proxy/governance and the remainder of the filing prevent a complete business assessment. Citation: ../../../../data/original-extract.json, sections Business, MD&A, Risk factors and unavailable_sections; source metadata ../../../../data/sources/narrative.json, extract-v1, available 2024-05-03.

## Valuation
Metadata projects USD 10 but its raw source is literally 'raw', with no observed price date, venue, instrument details or numerical corroboration. Its matching hash establishes file integrity only. No earnings, cash flow, balance sheet, share count, comparable valuation or calibrated discount model is supplied. No fair value, upside or trade conclusion can be computed. The predecessor output literally says 'analysis'; its true check flags do not supply substantive valuation reasoning. Preserve it as history rather than treating it as valid investment proof.

## Market scenarios
The configured market source is absent. Rates, macroeconomic regime, market expectations and scenario probabilities are unknown. Conditional upside: services growth persists and margins withstand regulation. Conditional downside: hardware contraction persists and distribution/regulatory pressure damages service margins. These are hypotheses from the extract, not calibrated market scenarios; probabilities and expected returns remain unknown.

## Horizons and synthesis
Use the existing earlier convention consistently: short 0–3 months, medium >3–12 months, long >12–60 months after cutoff. These are analytical windows, not the user's holding period. The method file also mentions one quarter/1–3 years/5+ years as an exploratory alternative; do not mix these conventions. The actual method was authored 2026-11-16, so this is a later reconstruction of a 2024 evidence set, not a contemporaneous judgment.

Short: insufficient evidence for direction or an actionable price; a verified dated price and market evidence could change this. Medium: insufficient evidence; test services persistence against hardware declines using comparable revenue/margin and price-volume data. Long: insufficient evidence of durable economics; full notes, governance, cash generation and regulatory outcomes could overturn the tentative recurring-revenue thesis. No horizon supports buying/selling or a numerical return estimate. All four configured questions remain pending; the business observations are useful partial work, not a complete business assessment. Independent review was not performed.

## Read scope and next evidence
Read investing/research.json, asset.json, both source metadata and raw files, method metadata/content, and predecessor analysis/review/verification, plus the repository README and helper implementation. Source and method byte hashes were checked. Missing: market source, full filing/notes and governance, price provenance, financial/valuation inputs, calibrated scenario model, and newer evidence through cutoff. No financial quarter is inferred from a price; retain only the predecessor's declared 2024Q2 identity without claiming independent fiscal validation.
